'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest-exclusive female expeditioner [[NPC]] who appears after the completion of {{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}. 

She can be found inside the [[Everfrost Cavern]], near the [[Exostrider Observation Station]] at 06<nowiki>:</nowiki>00-18<nowiki>:</nowiki>00, talking to others.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue== 
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Eva:''' Is that the [[SkyArk Space Station]] up ahead?
:'''Bren:''' Strange. Fallen objects like this would usually be swarmed by people trying to grab a piece. But not this one…
:'''Dimitri:''' I heard that the "[[Etheric Sea|droplets]]" are tricky to transport. The Institute's still figuring it out.
:'''Dimitri:''' Only a handful of people are allowed to investigate the interior right now. Probably to prevent damage.
:'''Bren:''' So mysterious... I really wanna see it myself.
:'''Eva:''' Even if we could, we probably wouldn’t understand much.
:'''Eva:''' I heard the [[Court of Savantae|written language]] used in that space station is completely different from Solaris's modern common script.
:'''Bren:''' Don't tell me you heard that from some "insider" again. I swear if you're messing with us—
:'''Eva:''' Hey, trust me! It's one hundred percent real!
:'''Eva:''' A friend from [[Huanglong]] told me similar characters have been found somewhere in [[Mengzhou]]...
{{Dialogue End}}
